noContext.title: No project context
noContext.body: This page is opened by the Project Chat command in Fusion. Open a design that lives in a Fusion Team project, then run the command again.

signIn.title: Sign in required
signIn.body: Sign in to your Autodesk account to join this project's chat.

hubConsent.title: Switch hub?
hubConsent.body: This design lives in the hub {{hub}}, but your session is signed in to {{sessionHub}}. Switching moves your whole session — including any open browser tabs — over to {{hub}}.

error.hubNotFound: None of your hubs matches this design's hub. Check that you signed in with the right Autodesk account.
error.projectNotFound: The project {{name}} is not accessible with this account.
error.lockFailed: Could not select this hub. Try again, or check the server logs.
